overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Board was scheduled to meet on September 14, 2026, to address a zoning change request, consider a Wisconsin Pollutant Discharge Elimination System memorandum of agreement, and handle staffing matters including an interim clerk appointment. The meeting was set to include administrative reports and public comment.

agenda.item: Resolution 2026-012, Wisconsin Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (WPDES) Memorandum of Agreement
Zoning Change Request - William Cywinski, 1900 Lea Road, 26.7 acres from AR (Agriculture and Residential) to RR5 (Rural Residential 5)
Appointment of interim clerk and set interim wage for position

discussions.item: Resolution 2026-012, Wisconsin Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (WPDES) Memorandum of Agreement
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to discuss and consider action on a WPDES Memorandum of Agreement resolution. This item was set for discussion and possible action at the September 14 meeting.

discussions.item: Zoning Change Request - William Cywinski, 1900 Lea Road
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to consider a zoning change request from William Cywinski for 26.7 acres located at 1904 Lea Road, seeking to reclassify the property from AR (Agriculture and Residential) to RR5 (Rural Residential 5). The parcel identification number is 145-2707-124-0977.

discussions.item: Appointment of interim clerk and set interim wage for position
discussions.body: The board was set to address staffing matters by considering the appointment of an interim clerk and establishing an interim wage for the position. This action item was scheduled for discussion and possible action.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled on the agenda, with a 15-minute total limit and three-minute per-person time limit, with possible extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
